steps.title: Define Application Metadata
steps.description: Establish the unique identity and package name structure for AetherCast EMF Sonifier to coordinate project-wide naming conventions.

steps.title: Configure Build Architecture
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with proper parameters matching target SDK 34, compiler specifications, and dependency exclusions.

steps.title: Establish Android System Manifest
steps.description: Declare hardware feature requirements including the magnetometer sensor, custom launcher, and hardware vibrator feedback nodes.

steps.title: Create Real-Time Vector Waveform Widget
steps.description: Program custom native Canvas drawing system (EMFVisualizerView.java) to chart three-dimensional raw magnetic vectors and historic flux waves.

steps.title: Develop Audio Synthesis Core
steps.description: Construct pure Java-based raw 16-bit PCM AudioTrack oscillator engine inside MainActivity to synthesise frequency-modulated physical waves.

steps.title: Implement Thread-Safe Sound Modulator
steps.description: Synthesize seamless frequency modifications using an isolated tracking phase loop to prevent audio pops and interface delays.

steps.title: Integrate Magnetometer State Machine
steps.description: Bind native SensorManager to poll the device's hardware magnetic sensor, extracting 3D vector coordinates for processing.

steps.title: Code Waveform Selector Mechanics
steps.description: Establish wave selector methods implementing Sine, Square, and Sawtooth hybrid raw physical audio waveforms.

steps.title: Construct Calibration Controls
steps.description: Incorporate base baseline zeroing and relative calibration features so environmental noise thresholds can be cancelled out dynamically.

steps.title: Write Adaptive Warning Alerts
steps.description: Program warning monitors that trigger vibration patterns and display flash indicators when magnetic bounds cross user thresholds.

steps.title: Design Session Logging Engine
steps.description: Create high-performance run logs tracking micro-Tesla spikes, average vectors, and chronological detection records.

steps.title: Layout Scientific User Dashboard
steps.description: Assemble a stylized, high-contrast, physical science telemetry screen displaying all digital measurements and control systems.

steps.title: Assemble Interface Layout Hooks
steps.description: Bridge XML buttons, seeker components, text screens, and logs with matching Activity lifecycle states and events.

steps.title: Optimize System Memory & Lifecycle Safety
steps.description: Ensure sound oscillators and hardware sensors release instantly when user leaves application to protect target battery limits.

steps.title: Execute Integrity Checks
steps.description: Verify XML namespaces, confirm Java 8 structures, remove non-compatible framework elements, and check class declarations.

steps.title: Building AetherCast EMF Sonifier
steps.description: Perform build steps compiling resource structures and packaging binary output into complete APK build.
